answer: We buy cars that don't run. Select stores will tow your car to the store at no charge, and your offer page shows which stores near you offer towing. Cars that don't run can't use home pickup, and the specialist confirms your offer after inspecting the car at the store. You don't need a payoff letter: Meridian Auto Loans is in our e-payoff network, so at your appointment we confirm the payoff directly with the lender the same day using your loan account number. Bring that account number with you.
